conventions.convention: For n≥1, P(k,x,z)=i^k X^x Z^z, with all X factors preceding all Z factors, k modulo 4, and binary coordinates over F₂. In particular Y=P(1,1,1).
Wires are numbered 1,…,n; wire j is tensor position j−1 in the suppliers' zero-based lists. Bitstrings use big-endian encoding.
Binary labels have order (x,z) and identify Pauli operators only after quotienting by the scalar center Z_n={i^k I}.
ω((x,z),(x′,z′))=x·z′+z·x′ over F₂. The form is alternating, symmetric, and nondegenerate.
The Clifford normalizer consists of actual unitary matrices satisfying U P_n U*=P_n. Distinct scalar global phases remain distinct unitaries.
A Clifford tableau stores generator images in order X₁,…,X_n,Z₁,…,Z_n as columns of S and exact modulo-4 phases in p. Only pairs arising from a Clifford qualify as Clifford tableaux.
The Pauli product phase uses the binary dot product evaluated as 0 or 1 before doubling modulo 4.

load_bearing.statement: P(k,x,z)P(k′,x′,z′)=P(k+k′+2(z·x′),x+x′,z+z′), where the binary dot product is evaluated as 0 or 1 before doubling modulo 4. P_n is a group; if p represents x·z, then P(k,x,z)*=P(2p−k,x,z)=P(k,x,z)⁻¹, and its center is Z_n={i^k I}.
The map π:P_n→V_n, P(k,x,z)↦(x,z), is a surjective group homomorphism with kernel exactly Z_n. Therefore P_n/Z_n≅(V_n,+), and dim_F₂ V_n=2n. No phase or label ambiguity occurs, including when n=1.
For a=(x,z), b=(x′,z′) in V_n and any phases k,k′, P(k,x,z)P(k′,x′,z′)=(−1)^ω(a,b) P(k′,x′,z′)P(k,x,z). Thus the Pauli operators commute exactly when their labels are symplectically orthogonal.
For P(k,x,z)=i^k X^x Z^z∈P_n, the operator is Hermitian exactly when k≡x·z modulo 2. In that case P(k,x,z)²=I.
For each U∈C_n, conjugation induces an invertible F₂-linear map S_U:V_n→V_n satisfying ω(S_Ua,S_Ub)=ω(a,b) for all a,b∈V_n. The assignment respects multiplication: S_UV=S_U∘S_V.

Let V be any finite-dimensional vector space over F₂ with a nondegenerate alternating form ω and dim V=2n. Every invertible linear map preserving ω is a finite composition of transvections τ_v(w)=w+ω(w,v)v. This is a choice-free finite-dimensional reduction.

For every nonzero v=(x,z)∈V_n, τ_v(w)=w+ω(w,v)v is induced on binary Pauli labels by an explicit Clifford circuit made from local H, S, S*, CNOT, and wire swaps. Its modulo-4 phase lift is computed by applying the exact gate update rules in sequence.

Independent spanning families, coordinate bases, and finite bases in the transvection reduction.
Dimensions of coordinate spaces and the zero-dimensional base case.
The adjoint appearing in the Clifford normalizer definition.
The finite-dimensional unitary convention in the Clifford normalizer and its group verification.
Linearity of quotient actions and pairing maps in the transvection argument.
Annihilators of proper subspaces of F₂² and F₂³, and the dimension of the orthogonal complement of a hyperbolic plane.

seams_checked.note: The controlled-access and CNOT suppliers define the control-first block and basis action used in the CNOT proof. The extension to arbitrary distinct wires preserves this action and introduces no access-cost claim.
The opened Pauli matrices, multiplication table, and exact H/S matrices support Y=iXZ, the Hadamard sign, and the modulo-4 phase-gate updates as stated.

The opened ordered-register, encoding, tensor-map, composition/adjoint, and encoding-bijection suppliers support the factorwise calculations. The local one-based wire convention explicitly translates the suppliers' zero-based positions.

The inspected citations preserve the label homomorphism, scalar kernel, Hermitian parity criterion, commutation iff, and exact row-product law. The tableau Clifford-update lemma reproduces the H, S, S†, and CNOT phase formulas. Zero-qubit cases use separate conventions rather than extending the n≥1 suppliers silently.

Syndrome, encoder, CSS commutation, logical-quotient, and surface-code citations use the stated phase-aware operators and symplectic commutation criterion. The logical-quotient theorem assumes n≥1 and uses nondegeneracy and dimension 2n with the same label order.

The inspected frame and graph-stabilizer citations retain P(x,z)=P(0,x,z)=X^xZ^z and the same commutation pairing. The CZ matching identity includes its quadratic scalar sign; empty-register frames are defined separately. Terminal correction uses the adjoint of the exact frame.
